learning_objective: 当和同伴想玩同一个玩具或活动时,孩子能轮流并等待自己的一轮(通过看一看、等一等、温和询问),而不是抢夺或哭闹。
intro_zh: 我和朋友在一起玩。桌上有一列小火车,我们都想玩。一次只能一个人玩,那我们可以轮流玩。
intro_en: My friend and I are playing together. There is a toy train on the table, and we both want it. Only one person can play at a time, so we can take turns.

steps.text_zh: 看到朋友在玩,我先看一看,等一等。
steps.text_en: When my friend is playing, I look and wait.
steps.narration_zh: 看到朋友正在玩,我先看一看,等一等,不去抢。
steps.narration_en: When my friend is playing, I look and wait. I do not grab.

steps.text_zh: 轮到别人时,我耐心等一小会儿,深呼吸。
steps.text_en: When it is someone else's turn, I wait calmly and take a breath.
steps.narration_zh: 轮到别人玩的时候,我耐心等一小会儿,深呼吸,让自己平静。
steps.narration_en: When it is someone else's turn, I wait calmly and take a slow breath.

steps.text_zh: 我可以轻声问:轮到我了吗?
steps.text_en: I can gently ask: Is it my turn?
steps.narration_zh: 等了一会儿,我可以用温和的声音问:请问,轮到我了吗?
steps.narration_en: After a little while, I can gently ask: Is it my turn now?

steps.text_zh: 轮到我了,我开心地玩,玩一会儿再换给朋友。
steps.text_en: On my turn, I play happily, then give it back to my friend.
steps.narration_zh: 轮到我了,我开心地玩一会儿,然后把玩具换给朋友,大家轮流玩。
steps.narration_en: On my turn, I play happily for a while, then give it back so we take turns.

practice_trials.prompt_zh: 朋友正在玩小火车,你也很想玩。轮到你,试着说说看、做做看。
practice_trials.prompt_en: Your friend is playing with the toy train, and you want it too. Your turn — give it a try.
practice_trials.answer_zh: 我先等一等,轮到我再玩。
practice_trials.answer_en: I will wait; I can play when it is my turn.
practice_trials.reinforce_zh: 你愿意先等一等,做得很好。
practice_trials.reinforce_en: You chose to wait. Well done.

practice_trials.prompt_zh: 你已经等了一会儿,想知道是不是该你了。你会怎么问?
practice_trials.prompt_en: You have waited a while and want to know if it is your turn. How can you ask?
practice_trials.answer_en: Excuse me, is it my turn now?
practice_trials.reinforce_zh: 你用温和的话来问,真棒。
practice_trials.reinforce_en: You asked with kind words. Great job.

practice_trials.prompt_zh: 你玩了一会儿小火车,朋友也想玩。你可以怎么做?
practice_trials.prompt_en: You have played with the train for a while, and your friend wants a turn. What can you do?
practice_trials.answer_en: It's your turn now — here you go.
practice_trials.reinforce_zh: 你主动和朋友轮流,做得好。
practice_trials.reinforce_en: You took turns with your friend. Well done.

social_choice.scenario_zh: 你们都想玩同一列小火车……你可以怎么做?
social_choice.scenario_en: You both want the same toy train... what can you do?

options.outcome_zh: 你们轮流玩,一人玩一会儿,都玩得很开心。
options.outcome_en: You take turns, and you both have a happy time.

options.label_zh: 先等一等,再问轮到我了吗
options.label_en: Wait, then ask for my turn
options.outcome_zh: 你耐心等一等,朋友很快让给你,你们相处得很好。
options.outcome_en: You wait patiently, your friend soon shares, and you get along well.

visual_cards.caption_zh: 看一看 → 等一等 → 轮到我
请问,轮到我了吗? / 该你了,给你玩。
visual_cards.caption_en: Is it my turn? / Here you go, your turn.

visual_cards.caption_zh: 等一等,深呼吸,我可以做到。
visual_cards.caption_en: Wait, breathe, I can do it.

visual_cards.caption_zh: 朋友玩 → 我玩 → 朋友玩
visual_cards.caption_en: Friend's turn → My turn → Friend's turn

review_zh: 我们轮流玩小火车,我会看一看、等一等,轮到我就开心地玩。我和朋友轮流,大家都很开心。
review_en: We take turns with the toy train. I look and wait, and on my turn I play happily. We take turns, and everyone is happy.
review_flags: 草稿:循证内容,正式使用前需专业人员按孩子的语言水平与真实同伴情境调整。
